earnings.title: Investor Relations: Sam Ramraj, 626-302- 2540
highlights: Third-quarter 2026 GAAP EPS of $1.88; core EPS of $1.92
Continued confidence in delivering 5% to 7% core EPS growth from 2025-2030

ROSEMEAD, Calif., Oct. 29, 2026 — Edison International (NYSE: EIX) today reported third-quarter net income of $724 million, or $1.88 per share, compared to net income of $832 million, or $2.16 per share, in the third quarter of last year.

quotes.text: Edison International posted another quarter of strong operational performance, with a focus on community safety and customer affordability.

outlook: Reaffirmed 2026 core EPS guidance of $5.90 to $6.20
